title: Understanding Expo Project Structure
overview: An Expo project contains files and folders that organize screens, assets, configurations, and application logic.

example.title: Basic Structure
example.content:
MyApp/
 ├── app/
 ├── assets/
 ├── components/
 ├── package.json
 └── app.json

title: App Folder
overview: The app folder contains application routes and screens when using Expo Router.

title: Assets Folder
overview: The assets folder stores static resources like images, fonts, and icons used inside the application.

title: Configuration Files
overview: Expo uses configuration files to define application settings, permissions, and build information.

title: Components and Utilities
overview: Reusable components and utility functions help keep Expo applications clean and maintainable.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned about Expo folders, routing structure, assets, configuration files, and organizing application code.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
✔ app contains screens.
✔ assets stores resources.
✔ Config files manage settings.
✔ Components improve reuse.
